notes.title: Winds of Change Demo Released
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25096360/91feb4c4059eac8eecef43b2f71e5e83dfa7fa7f.png

Hey Everybody!

A Winds of Change Demo has been patched into Major\Minor.
When you click PLAY, you can choose the Winds of Change Demo!

It's the new game from Tall Tail Studios, coming in 2019.
Please check out the demo and check out the Patreon!

www.patreon.com/winds

Some of the features in Winds of Change are:

- Full Voice Acting by a professional cast
- Orchestral Score over 2 hours long
- Interaction with the Environment, and World Maps
- Open World Flow (Once you unlock an area, you can always come back)
- The ability to stop at any time and chat with your party members
- Hidden books in the environment to provide lore and insight
- Parallel Chronicles: See what characters around the world are up to
- Party Banter: Stop and observe skits of your party members interacting

We hope you like it! The demo is several hours long.
It's been about a year of work to make this build happen.

Klace
Tall Tail Studios
Creative Director

notes.title: Winds of Change Kickstarter LIVE!
notes.content:
Hello Saviors!

The Kickstarter for our newest game is now live!

Here's a link to check it out, we are honored by any support!
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/372114443/winds-of-change-2

As well as a shortened link for sharing on social media:
http://kck.st/2lMkMTU

As well as that, a new patch for Major\Minor was released.
We are calling this the REDUX patch.
It's aimed to increase quality of life while playing Major\Minor.
As well as expedite subsequent playthrough.

Here are the notes for this patch:

- The game no longer launches in full screen.
- You can now use your keyboard to enter your name.
- Holding Page Down skips text MUCH faster than before.
- Text now extends to both edges of the screen.
- Save screen is fully re-vamped, showing many details.
- Black Gradient in the border bars has been removed.
- Typos and Grammatical Errors that remained have been fixed.
- If you don't get the True Ending, you can replay the game with flags intact.
- Command Remember has been removed from the options menu.

Thank you very much everyone!
Please report any bugs about this patch on the forums.

Kyle "Klace" Lambert
Tall Tail Studios
Project Lead and Head Writer

notes.title: Patch 26 Released
notes.content:
Hello Saviors,

A patch was just released for Major\Minor.
Here are some of the changes/additions:

- The after-credits scene in the True Ending has been revised.
- Chapter Four has been re-written/revised in its entirety.
- Reiyo may respond to certain names during name input.
- The Achievements associated with after-credits scenes now unlock faster.
- All Chapters have had typos and inconsistencies fixed.
- A warning has been added when you reach the point of no return.
- Several unprompted save points were given prompts to avoid auto-saving.
- Reiyo's portrait in the dialogue box will now reflect his hood status.
- A splash screen has been added before the title screen, showing our logo.
- Removed "Always Dash" option from the Options Menu.
- Re-wrote the opening scene that takes place in The Ark.

We are pushing ahead to our final release in October.
Thank you very much for all the feedback about the finale.
I am very honored to receive such feedback after this long journey.
Please report any typos in the Chapter Four revision on the forums.


Kyle "Klace" Lambert
Tall Tail Studios
Project Lead and Head Writer

notes.title: Chapter Nine + Patch 25 Released
notes.content:
Hello Saviors!

Chapter Nine has been released for Major\Minor!
As well as a new patch that brings some tweaks.

Here are a few of the changes/additions as we prepare for the finale.

- 11 Achievements have been added for the new Chapter
- The dialogue window has changed slightly in color
- The user interface has changed, choices now display differently

The final chapter will be released in the coming months.
I am targeting a release of the Complete edition for Fall 2016.

Thanks!

Kyle "Klace" Lambert

notes.title: Major\Minor - Patch 20 Released
notes.content:
Hello Community!

Another big patch was released for Major\Minor today.
Here are some of the changes you'll encounter:

- The new finalized trailer has been uploaded to the Store Page.

- Chapter One has been 100% re-written and revised.

- This is a fully new re-write, superseding the previous revision.

- Chapter Two has been 100% re-written and revised.

- Spelling and grammar errors in Chapter Two have been fixed.

- Chapter Three has been revised further. Full re-write in the works.

So over the last two weeks -- 30% of the game has been re-written.
This is to fix any tonal inconsistencies and make the game more engaging.
It is now easier and more enjoyable than ever to progress the plot.

My goal was to make the journey to Chapter Four even better.
In my opinion -- that's where the plot comes fully into play.
But now, the earlier Chapters match the quality of the recent Chapters.

This was a large undertaking and I am very proud of it.
Please look forward to the Chapter Three re-writes and revisions.
And after that -- the development and release of Chapter Seven.

Kyle "Klace" Lambert
Tall Tail Studios
Project Lead and Head Writer

notes.title: Patch 19 Released
notes.content:
Hello Community!

A patch was just released for Major\Minor.
Here are some of the changes present:

- The Terra portions of Chapter One were entirely re-written/revised.

- This brings Chapter One to be about 80% re-written since launch.

- Chapter Two has been entirely re-written/revised.

- Chapter Three has been approximately 10% re-written/revised.

I've been editing the previous chapters with a new philosophy:

"Say more with less."

You will find that previous chapters are now more succinct and less wordy.
This will allow players to progress the story in a clear and quick fashion.
Chapters Four, Five and Six are seemingly up to par with this standard.

Please look forward to further Chapter Three revisions.
As well as minimal revisions to Chapter Four in the future.

The release of Chapter Seven is tentatively set as August 2016.

This revision project is a large undertaking.
But the overall quality of the product will increase dramatically.
We are still looking at a finished launch later this year, or early next year.

Thanks!

Kyle "Klace" Lambert
Tall Tail Studios
Project Lead and Head Writer

notes.title: Chapter 6 + Patch 17 Released
notes.content:
Hello Community!

Chapter 6 -- "Life\Death" has just released, and is the largest chapter so far.
It comes in at about 20,000 words and has lots of content.
14 Achievements were added into the game for this new chapter.

It has some of the largest events and revelations in the plot so far.
So please be mindful of spoilers when discussing with others.
There is a designated topic on the forums to discuss the new chapter.

But new features have been implemented as well.
Including an overhaul of the previous 5 chapters.

Details are as follows for Patch 17:

- A distinctive sound effect will play each time a True Ending Flag is attained. This will help people keep track of how many they have if they are paying close attention to the game as they play.

- The alternate portraits of every character have been implemented, and will be highlighted in a CG as they make their entrance into the story and meet the protagonist for the first time.

- Every single choice has been reworded, making it seem more like an active dialogue choice instead of a passive action choice. This will help immersion into the shoes of the protagonist.

- Feedback will appear upon making your choices, and can manifest itself in many possible ways.

- A warning will be given if you are about to make a choice that will change the flow of the story. 

- You will be given brief insight into how the characters feel about the way you are treating them. This -- along with the True Ending Flag audio cue will allow players to steer their playthrough in the direction they want without seeking too much external guidance.

Thanks so much for all your support!
I worked extremely hard on this latest chapter.
I hope that you are all able to enjoy it.

And the retroactive overhauls ensure that the game is an even greater experience for those who are playing for the first time! So this dual release is a win/win scenario. :)

Kyle "Klace" Lambert
Tall Tail Studios
Project Lead and Head Writer
